jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for "experts" to join an unpaid Advisory Committee, not a paid entry-level role — it seeks established specialists to advise a project, which the candidate is not, and there is no salaried vacancy. Although the human-rights/securitisation subject is on-mission, it is a volunteer advisory position rather than a genuine paid job.

jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established "experts" to sit on an advisory committee, not an entry-level paid role — it seeks senior specialists with a track record on climate justice / human-rights defenders, which the candidate does not have. It is also effectively an advisory / voluntary appointment rather than a genuine paid vacancy, and the underlying activist network spans East Africa, Latin America and Southeast Asia (Spanish-language framing), none of which fits the candidate's profile.

jobs.title: Research Analyst
jobs.reason: Genuinely entry-level and a solid fit for the candidate's research, writing and analysis skills, so a realistic application. Global development/poverty policy sits outside the three core interest zones (international law, geopolitical risk, OSINT/tech policy), which holds interest and priority down, though it remains adjacent research worth surfacing. Based in London, so it passes the location filter.

jobs.title: Senior Policy Analyst I
jobs.reason: The "Senior" title signals a role beyond entry-level, requiring several years of relevant experience the candidate does not have. Even setting the field aside, the seniority is a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Policy Fellow or Senior Policy Fellow, US Development Policy Program
jobs.reason: Location policy is London only, and this role is tied to Washington DC with no London or remote-UK option, so it is a hard filter fail. It is also a senior fellowship beyond entry-level.

jobs.title: IATF Lead Auditor
jobs.reason: Ineligible on multiple hard grounds: it is a "Lead" role requiring at least four years of automotive-industry experience, essential fluency in Dutch (a language the candidate does not have), and technical automotive-quality knowledge (ISO 9001 / IATF 16949, APQP, PPAP, FMEA) the candidate wholly lacks. The subject is entirely outside the candidate's interest and skill areas.
